text: Not all days were checked for thermal detections in the initial run (run-1). The period 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-08 was analyzed, but coverage was incomplete for October 8th due to data not being published yet (e.g., "after the latest NRT file update"). However, a later run (run-2) confirmed full coverage for all days, showing no detections. The system initially missed October 8th but later verified it was covered.
